cells.gaps: LBY-001's briefs were drafted with academics, civil society and government bodies; no source found since October 2023 says they went to a consultation, were commissioned by government, or fed a named digital policy, law or strategy.
cells.note: Held at 3: LBY-001, the October 2024 ANNIR policy briefs, answers question 2. Drafting briefs in a working group that included government bodies is not evidence to a consultation, a government commission or a seat on an advisory body on a named policy, law or strategy, so question 3 is not met (ruling 114).
